question: Who became the new CEO of Scale AI in August 2026?

hits.title: Meta AI head shares message for Google Cloud head, who announced he is joining ScaleAI; the company Alexandr Wang founded, but left to head Mark Zuckerberg's AI division.
hits.snippet: [hires | 2026-07-31] Scale AI, Inc. hired DeSouza as CEO on Jul 31st '26. DeSouza, who also served as president of Google Cloud's security products business, said he was drawn to Scale because enterprises need help turning AI hype into measurable business results.
hits.summary: Scale AI, Inc. hired DeSouza as CEO on Jul 31st '26.

hits.title: Scale AI appoints Francis deSouza as Chief Executive Officer.
hits.snippet: [hires] Scale AI, Inc. is planning to hire deSouza as Chief Executive Officer. As CEO, deSouza will oversee Scale AI's strategic direction, product innovation, and global business operations.
hits.summary: Scale AI, Inc. is planning to hire deSouza as Chief Executive Officer.

hits.title: Scale AI taps former Google Cloud executive as CEO.
hits.snippet: [hires | 2026-08-10] Scale AI, Inc. plans to hire Francis DeSouza as chief executive officer on Aug 10th '26. July 30 - Scale AI said on Thursday it had named former Google Cloud executive Francis DeSouza as chief executive officer, effective August 10, as the AI company looks to expand its data and applications businesses.
hits.summary: Scale AI, Inc. plans to hire Francis DeSouza as chief executive officer on Aug 10th '26.

hits.title: Meta invests $14.3 billion in Scale AI, brings CEO Alexandr Wang onboard
hits.snippet: [promotes] Scale AI, Inc. promotes Jason Droege to CEO. Wang also revealed that Chief Strategy Officer Jason Droege would be promoted to the role of Scale AI's CEO.
hits.summary: Scale AI, Inc. promotes Jason Droege to CEO.

hits.title: Zuckerberg hires Scale AI boss, injects IDR230 trillion to pursue AI
hits.snippet: [hires] Scale AI, Inc. hires Jason Droege as CEO. As Wang's replacement, Scale AI appointed Chief Strategy Officer Jason Droege as its new CEO.
hits.summary: Scale AI, Inc. hires Jason Droege as CEO.

hits.title: Scale AI gets into the synthetic data game – TechCrunch – Tech4Mag
hits.snippet: [hires] Scale AI, Inc. hires Joel Kronander. Scale hired Joel Kronander, who previously headed up machine learning at Nines and was a former computer vision engineer at Apple working on 3D mapping, as its new head of synthetic data.
hits.summary: Scale AI, Inc. hires Joel Kronander.

hits.title: Scale LLP Hires Silicon Valley Fintech Duo
hits.snippet: [hires | 2021-09-27] Scale AI, Inc. hired Alexander Gershen on Sep 27th '21. Scale LLP, the Silicon Valley-based distributed law firm, announced today that it has hired San Francisco fintech team Jamie Wells and Alexander Gershen to join the firm’s Fintech & Financial Services group.
hits.summary: Scale AI, Inc. hired Alexander Gershen on Sep 27th '21.

hits.title: Virtual Law Firm Scale LLP Hires David Reidy As Managing Partner | Business Wire
hits.snippet: [hires] Scale AI, Inc. hires David Reidy as managing partner. Scale LLP, a fast-growing distributed law firm based in Silicon Valley, announced that it has hired industry veteran David Reidy as Managing Partner.
